QuestInfo.name: Gathering the Research Material
QuestInfo.0: Something is wrong with Russellon, the Alchemist of Alcadno. Go ask what.
QuestInfo.1: Russellon explains that his Research Diary has been scattered while he looked away and is requesting that you go retrieve the #r Alcadno Research Diary#k taken by the Mutae.
QuestInfo.2: You've gathered the Alcadno Research Diary taken by the Mutae for Russellon.

0.0: Something like this happens every single time I get distracted. The Mutae are mischievous little things, but I never thought they'd take the Research Diary. Maed's gonna tear me apart if I don't get it back.
0.1: You know Maed's temper is... well, you know Maed is always in a rush. I'll need to stay up all night to get a new document ready. This kind of stuff always happens to us low-rankers. But first I need to recover the lost Research Diary. Can you help me?

yes.0: There are total of #r8#k #rAlcadno Research Diary#k pages. I will need all eight to complete my report. Make sure you get all 8. Thanks.

no.0: Well, if you don't want to help then I guess it's all on me.

1.0: Did you get all the Research Diary pages?

yes.0: I'm glad we got these back, but I'm not looking forward to this report I have to write again.

default.0: I will lock these up next time. I can't have something like this happening again.
